evidence.quote: A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

observations.why: Self-described as a positioning note for tooling — meta-instrumental, not a position the speaker commits to or acts on; exploratory framing locates at notion.

evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Unhedged categorical distinction stated as bedrock; the parallel structure and absence of any softening perform a constitutive value the speaker treats as self-evident — principle-grade conviction.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Semicolon-joined second clause restates and deepens the thesis as a permanent value — the perspective-as-asset framing is creed-like, not argued for but asserted as constitutive.

evidence.quote:
This restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis so a navigating
extractor has existing positioning to connect to.

observations.why: Self-aware restatement for downstream tooling — asserts the thesis as settled enough to restate, but the meta framing (purpose is to give an extractor something to connect to) keeps it at claim rather than principle; the conviction is in the assertion, not in creed-level permanence.
